newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Alliance Group issues bond prospectus.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Alliance Group issues bond prospectus.

text.p: South Island meat processor and exporter Alliance Group Ltd said on Friday it was issuing a prospectus for an offer of up to NZ$30 million of three and five year bonds.
Interest will be paid at 10.75 percent for the three year bonds, and 11.0 percent for the five year bonds.
Payments will be made half yearly in June and December.
Lead manager for the issue is Merrill Lynch (New Zealand) Ltd.
"The purpose of this issue is to achieve a higher level of flexibility in medium term and seasonal funding under refinancing arrangements," said Alliance chairman John Falconer.

He said the issue would further consolidate the improvement achieved in Alliance's position since a programme was undertaken in 1991 to improve cash flow, restore profitability and restructure the balance sheet.
Peak seasonal finance requirements will continue to be through bank facilities.
